clips.title: The story
paras: At Blackthorn Ridge, Razormane quilboar guard the southern Barrens north of Razorfen Kraul. Brine, an orc shaman, keeps watch from a camp above a pool of unusually pure mountain water.

Blackthorn Ridge rises beside Razorfen Kraul, its slopes crowded with dense thickets of sharp briars. The Razormane quilboar claim the ground as ancestral territory, using the thorny barriers to ambush outsiders and skirmish across the southern Barrens. Travelers seek out the ridge despite the danger, drawn to Brine, a hermit orc shaman. His camp sits above a spring famed across Kalimdor for its clear, spiritually pure water.
